This '''customized Basilisk war droid''' was the personal war mount of [[Mandalore the Indomitable]]. Mandalore's [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] was a customized version of the regular model, and it was customized specifically to his requirements and specifications. Mandalore the Indomitable is known to have had used it throughout the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], such as during the [[Duel on Kuar]] and the [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|Battle of Onderon]]. It was eventually destroyed during battle shortly before the death of Mandalore the Indomitable.
